description: EGS: start the daily sweep on the first message of the day, and keep Claude read-only in EGS's tools. Connector tools stay blocked if the guard cannot run.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sweep_gate.py" || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sweep_gate.py" || echo "[EGS] The EGS scripts could not run on this computer (Python is missing, or the script failed), so there is no daily sweep and the connector tools are blocked. Load the egs-connect skill and set up Python first."

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard.py" || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard.py" || (echo "EGS read-only guard could not run (Python is missing, or the guard failed), so connector tools stay blocked. Load the egs-connect skill and set up Python first." 1>&2 && exit 2)
